sources.name: Florida Memory
sources.license: Public Domain Mark 1.0. Florida Memory offers the images on the site under this mark. Credit the State Archives of Florida, Florida Memory, as required by section 257.35(6), Florida Statutes.
sources.depicts: Postcard PC2170, Plaza Venetia - Marriott - Miami, published by Gulfstream Card Co. The catalog date of circa 1900 is a placeholder; the towers date the card to after 1979. Seen from Biscayne Bay, the southern tower with yellow vertical stripes is The Venetia at 555 NE 15th Street. The white balcony tower to the north is the Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay, 1633 North Bayshore Drive, and is not The Venetia. A shorter gray tower stands between them.

building:4462000.identity: Unnamed 27.6 ft building, OpenStreetMap way 435527718, Miami building reference 20528. It stands on Northeast 16th Street, immediately south of Trinity Episcopal Cathedral and southwest of The Venetia. The mapped footprint has no name or street address.
